description: Get one journal entry (verifikation) by id, as Bokio returns it. To find entries by date use bokio_list_journal_entries.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

journalEntryId.description: Id from bokio_list_journal_entries; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

name: bokio_get_journal_entry
